name: Russia–NATO
summary: Poland keeps a large security operation on its Kaliningrad border after warnings of Russian provocations
state: Poland's police chief said a security operation along the Kaliningrad border, involving police, counter-terrorism units and GROM special forces, runs from 2 Nov until at least 8 Nov, after PM Donald Tusk said on 3 Nov that suspicious movements near the border had been seen (CBS News). NATO's top commander had warned of possible provocations (Stars and Stripes). No member had requested Article 4 consultations as of 7 Nov.
for_you: No change for travellers; follow Polish authorities and FCDO advice near the Kaliningrad border.
rubric_hit: Explicit warnings of Russian provocations on NATO territory = Watch

sources.title: CBS News — Poland launches major border operation
Stars and Stripes — NATO's military chief tells Poland to keep wary eye on border

why: Direct Russia–NATO confrontation is the most likely path to a European war involving the UK.

rubric.alert: Article 4 consultations, a direct military clash, or an attack on NATO territory.
rubric.watch: Airspace/drone violations, sabotage attributed to Russia, or explicit threats against members.
rubric.normal: No notable incidents on NATO territory in the past two weeks.
